feature: Add Content-Security-Policy and security meta tags to generated gallery page
workflow_rationale: Single-service task modifying only the HTML generator script to add security meta tags. No multi-service dependencies, no migration needed, straightforward implementation with clear verification steps.

phases.name: Add Security Meta Tags
phases.description: Modify rebuild-index.py to generate CSP and security meta tags with SHA-256 hashes for inline scripts and styles

subtasks.description: Add helper function to calculate SHA-256 hash for CSP
subtasks.implementation_notes: Add a compute_csp_hash(content) function that calculates base64-encoded SHA-256 hash for CSP script-src and style-src directives. Place it near the top of the file after imports.

verification.command: python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts'); from rebuild_index import compute_csp_hash; print('OK' if compute_csp_hash('test') else 'FAIL')"

subtasks.description: Modify write_gallery() to add security meta tags with CSP hashes
subtasks.implementation_notes: In write_gallery() function after line 301, add: (1) Content-Security-Policy meta tag with script-src using SHA-256 hashes for both inline scripts, style-src with hash for inline styles, frame-ancestors 'none', img-src for GitHub raw URLs; (2) Referrer-Policy meta tag; (3) X-Frame-Options meta tag; (4) X-Content-Type-Options meta tag. Calculate hashes for TAG_SCRIPT constant and the script in recolour_section(), and the inline style block.

subtasks.description: Regenerate index.html with security meta tags
subtasks.implementation_notes: Run python3 scripts/rebuild-index.py to regenerate index.html with the new security meta tags. The generated file should contain CSP, Referrer-Policy, X-Frame-Options, and X-Content-Type-Options meta tags.

phases.name: Verify Security Implementation
phases.description: Verify that security meta tags are present and correctly configured, and that page functionality is not broken

subtasks.description: Verify all security meta tags are present in generated HTML
subtasks.implementation_notes: Check that index.html contains: Content-Security-Policy with proper directives, Referrer-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options. Verify CSP includes SHA-256 hashes for both inline scripts.

verification.instructions: Open index.html in a browser and check: (1) No CSP violations in console, (2) Copy button works on recolour prompts, (3) Tag filtering works, (4) Section highlighting works on scroll, (5) All images load correctly

subtasks.implementation_notes: Open index.html in a browser with DevTools. Check Console for any CSP violations. If violations appear, the hashes are incorrect and need recalculation.

checks: No CSP violation errors in console
Interactive features (copy button, tag filter) work
Images load from GitHub raw URLs

parallelism.speedup_estimate: Sequential execution required (verification depends on implementation)

acceptance_criteria: Content-Security-Policy meta tag present with correct SHA-256 hashes
No CSP violations in browser console
All page functionality works (copy button, tag filter, section highlight)
Images load correctly from GitHub raw URLs

verification_steps.name: Check Security Headers
verification_steps.expected_outcome: All four security meta tags present

verification_steps.name: Browser Verification
verification_steps.expected_outcome: Page loads with no CSP violations, all features work

verification_strategy.reasoning: Low risk defensive security enhancement - adds protection without changing functionality. Manual browser testing required to verify CSP hashes are correct and no legitimate scripts are blocked.
